title: Smoke Signal
overview: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

title: Pain
overview: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

title: Old Story
overview: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

title: Trust
overview: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

title: Reply
overview: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

title: Sin
overview: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

title: Wish
overview: As battle breaks out to prevent the ritual, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

title: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
overview: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

title: Ruler of the Walls
overview: The survey corps and the wall garrison must protect the Orvud District from the impending attack of Rod Reiss' titan.

title: Friends
overview: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

title: Bystander
overview: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
overview: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.
